notes.note: Since this length of time during which the woman is nourished seems to be the same as in 12:6, it seems that three and a half years is intended. If it would be helpful to your readers, you could say that explicitly. Alternate translation: [for a year and two years and half a year] or [for three and a half years]
Here the word face represents the presence of a person by association with the way people can see the face of someone who is present. Alternate translation: [the presence of the serpent]

verses.text: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.

xrefs.text: the Lord will surely bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates the king of Assyria and all his pomp. It will overflow its channels and overrun its banks.
The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
So shall they fear the name of the LORD where the sun sets, and His glory where it rises. For He will come like a raging flood, driven by the breath of the LORD.
You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
Behold, the Lord has one who is strong and mighty. Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest, like a driving rain or flooding downpour, he will smash that crown to the ground.
Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.

notes.note: John says that this water was like a river to emphasize how much water there was. If it would be clearer in your language, you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [a very large volume of water]
Alternate translation: [in order to create a flood that would carry her away]

verses.text: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.

xrefs.text: The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning and evening, and he would drink from the brook.
Furthermore, the Israelites acted on Moses’ word and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold, and for clothing.

notes.note: John is speaking of the earth as if it were a living thing that helped this woman. This may be something that readers could understand literally within the world of this vision. However, if it would be helpful to your readers, you could state the meaning differently. Alternate translation: [something happened on the earth that helped the woman]

notes.quote: ἤνοιξεν ἡ γῆ τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς
notes.note: John is speaking as if the earth literally had a mouth and swallowed this river. He means that some kind of chasm opened up in the earth and the river flowed down into it. If it would be clearer in your language, you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [a chasm opened up in the earth and the river flowed down into it]

verses.text: And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.

xrefs.text: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.
And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
When the two witnesses have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will wage war with them, and will overpower and kill them.
Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
This is what he said: ‘The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on the earth, different from all the other kingdoms, and it will devour the whole earth, trample it down, and crush it.

notes.note: If your language does not use this passive form, you could express the idea in active form or in another way that is natural in your language. Alternate translation: [this put the dragon in a rage]

Here the term seed means offspring. It is a word picture. Just as plants produce seeds that grow into many more plants, so people can have many offspring. If it would be clearer in your language, you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [of her descendants]
See how you translated the word keeping in 1:3 and in 2:26. Alternate translation: [obeying]
If your language does not use an abstract noun for the idea of testimony, you could express the same idea in another way. Alternate translation: [testifying to their faith in Jesus]

named.name: Jesus
named.brief: The Son of God and Savior of the world.
